gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes classifying a rigid inclusion installation method by soil-displacement behaviour - whether the technique pushes soil aside, removes it, or something between - distinct from diggs:RigidInclusionType/columnType, which names the rig/technique family rather than its displacement behaviour. Used for the value of diggs:RIConstructionActivityType/diggs:installationMethod.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Rigid Inclusion Installation Method (Soil Displacement) Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A continuous-flight or displacement auger that advances by pushing soil radially outward with no spoil removal, densifying and laterally stressing the surrounding ground as it penetrates.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Full-displacement auger

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A method that removes some spoil while displacing the remainder, an intermediate case between full displacement and pre-drill/spoil removal.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Partial displacement

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A displacement tool advanced with a drilling (rotary) action rather than pure static push, combining drilling penetration with lateral soil displacement.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Drilled displacement

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The hole is pre-drilled and spoil removed before or during grout placement, with no net soil displacement into the surrounding ground.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Pre-drill / spoil removed
